title: NTSB issues investigative update on B-767 runway excursion accident in Miami
summary: The NTSB published an investigative update on a Boeing 767 runway excursion accident at Miami airport, providing preliminary findings and ongoing investigation details from the National Transportation Safety Board's official investigation process.
problem_solved: This NTSB investigation provides official documentation and preliminary findings for the B-767 runway excursion incident to establish probable cause and issue safety recommendations.
why_valuable: It offers transparency on aviation safety investigations and helps the industry learn from incidents to prevent future runway excursions.
